title: 2023 Panini Prizm #135 Evan Engram Jacksonville Jaguars Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
For avid fans of football, this Evan Engram 2023 Panini Prizm #135 trading card is a must-have for your collection. Featuring the Jacksonville Jaguars player in his signature pose, this card is an original from the Panini Prizm set. With its Prizm parallel/variety, this card stands out from the rest and is sure to catch the eye of any collector. 

This single card is in great shape and is near mint/mint condition. It is an original from the manufacturer, Panini Group, and is an English language product. The card is part of the base set and has features that are consistent with modern trading cards. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is sure to impress.
